stem: Aspirin use in children or teenagers with viral illness raises concern for which serious complication?

options.label: A
options.text: Mandatory type 1 diabetes onset within hours

options.label: B
options.text: Immediate anaphylaxis from ACE-inhibitor bradykinin alone
options.explanation: Aspirin Reye risk is not ACE anaphylaxis.

options.label: C
options.text: Reye syndrome affecting brain and liver fat stores
options.explanation: MedlinePlus: Reye syndrome with fat buildup in brain and liver.

options.label: D
options.text: Complete loss of innate immunity in hours
options.misconception: Immuno overclaim — does not match the cited teaching point.

options.label: E
options.misconception: Stats distractor — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Wrong domain; see the cited source passage for detail.

context: Learning objective: aspirin and Reye syndrome risk.
